_about: SERIES SHELF of one-off translators: The History of Civilization (Kegan Paul, London, and Knopf, New York, 1925-), C. K. Ogden's English edition of Henri Berr's L'Évolution de l'Humanité. Febvre's Geographical Introduction to History (Mountford and Paxton), Moret and Davy's From Tribe to Empire and Delaporte's Mesopotamia (V. Gordon Childe), Huart's Ancient Persia and Moret's The Nile and Egyptian Civilization (M. R. Dobie), Pittard's Race and History (V. C. C. Collum), Renard and Weulersse's Life and Work in Modern Europe (Margaret Richards) and Perrier's The Earth before History (Paul Radin), 1925-1927. Boissonnade's volume, translated by Eileen Power, is on her shelf. The series' Greek and Roman volumes (Glotz, Jardé, Homo) are left for Lane B. Every volume prints a series list naming several translators, so each attribution was read from the title page. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 59); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.

hoc-moret-nile.author: The OCR of this 1927 scan lost the translator's name. The same work's 1972 reissue (archive.org in.ernet.dli.2015.107710) reads 'Translated by M. R. DOBIE' on its title page; checked by eye 2026-10-17.
